svg.title: Kähler abundance after nonvanishing supplies Assumption 2.4 of conditional fourfold models. Log Abundance supplies the projective anchor for all-dimensional Kähler abundance; dimension-free lemmas in the conditional fourfold paper supply strata adjunction and strict comparison.

a.aria-label: Theorem 1.1 · p. 3: Gives semiampleness once nonvanishing is obtained for the nef Kähler klt fourfold adjoint. The other two premises remain separate.

Proposition 2.5 / Theorem 9.6 / §10 · pp. 9–12, 69–73: Uses Log Abundance’s full induction under the stated logarithmic subadditivity assumption to supply projective good models and effective exceptional comparison.

Lemmas 7.16–7.17 · pp. 58–60: Supplies actual adjunction on normalized strata and strict discrepancy comparison over the exceptional locus. Both lemmas are dimension-free; the fourfold main theorem is not applied in all dimensions.
